subject: general
question: Who among the following personalities was the chief draftsman of the constituent assembly that drafted the document of the Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is SN Mukherjee

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SN Mukherjee:-**

 
 
• He was the chief draftsman of the constituent assembly that drafted the document of the Constitution.
 
• He was a prominent lawyer, politician, and freedom fighter who played a significant role in the Indian independence movement.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **KM Munshi:-**

 
 
• He was also a member of the constituent assembly and contributed to the drafting of the Constitution, but he was not the chief draftsman.
 
 
 
• **H. V. R. Iyengar:-**
 
 
• He was the sixth Governor of the Reserve Bank of India from 1 March 1957 to 28 February 1962.
 
• He was a member of the Indian Civil Service, entering service on 20 October 1926.
 
 
 
• **Vasant Krishan Vaidya:-**
 
 
• He was a Gujarati poet, writer, and translator.
 
• He was born in 1924 in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
 
• He studied at Gujarat University, where he received a Master of Arts degree in Gujarati literature.
